content: Aditi Mahajan contacted insurance agent Karan Joshi to set up auto-debit for her new Health Plus Plus plan. Karan provided the e-mandate form and requested a cancelled cheque or bank statement. Aditi successfully uploaded the required document in JPG format, and Karan confirmed the auto-debit setup with the first premium of ₹12,480 scheduled for October 5, 2026.

action_items: Debit first premium of ₹12,480 on October 5, 2026
